title: fix(metadata)!: refuse a flow with an undeclared cycle at publish, as the engine refuses it at registration
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi92ir5G3Q6HWZpySnE18mErT)_
Fixes #29025

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：流程里闭合回环的那条边没标 `type: 'back'` 时，草稿读取现在报 `valid: false`（错误码 `flow-undeclared-cycle`，定位到闭环边），单项发布和整包发布都拒收（422）。环检测从 service-automation 挪到 metadata-core 成为唯一判定，引擎注册和发布门都调它。
- 为什么改：以前这种流程草稿显示有效、发布成功，然后引擎拒绝注册，流程永远不跑，只有启动日志里能看到原因。
- 风险与回滚：只拒收引擎本来就不会注册的流程；任一环边标了 back 的回环照常发布和注册（对照用例已钉住）。引擎的报错文字不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.ts`（`findFlowCycleGaps` 与并入 `localIssues` 的一行）、`packages/metadata-core/src/flow-cycle.ts`（判定本体，原样搬自引擎）、`packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-registration-checks.ts`（`detectCycles` 改为调用共享判定）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/runtime-authoring-gate.flow-cycle.test.ts src/protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts`，预期全部通过，含「未标 back 被拒」与「标 back 的同一回环照常发布」两条。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/metadata-core/src/flow-cycle.ts` (new): `findUndeclaredFlowCycle(flow)` and `undeclaredFlowCycleMessage(path)`. The DFS is the engine's `detectCycles` body, moved unedited, plus the index of the cycle-closing edge so a door can locate the finding. Exported from the package root.
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-registration-checks.ts`: `detectCycles` now throws `findUndeclaredFlowCycle(flow).message`. Same walk, same sentence, same throw site; the engine's behaviour does not change.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.ts`: a gate-local rule `flow-undeclared-cycle` (`FLOW_UNDECLARED_CYCLE`, `findFlowCycleGaps`), folded into the gate's one verdict and disclosed in `rulesRun` for every flow. Severity `error`, path `flows[0].edges[N]` (the closing edge, which `_diagnostics` re-spells `edges.N`), message = the engine's sentence. Because the draft verdict (#26707) reads the same gate, the draft read now says `valid: false`, and the per-item publish, the live save and `publish-drafts` refuse it.
- `packages/metadata-core/src/flow-cycle-corpus.ts` (new, exported from `@objectstack/metadata-core/testing` only): `FLOW_CYCLE_CORPUS`, eight complete flow bodies with the expected verdict (four refused, four that must register), driven by the judge's, the engine's and the gate's suites.
- `.changeset/29025-flow-undeclared-cycle-publish.md`: `metadata-protocol` and `metadata-core` minor, `service-automation` patch; BREAKING banner with before / now, `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

Why gate-local and not an `AUTHORING_RULES` entry: the registry lives in `@objectstack/lint`, which can reach only `spec`, `formula` and `sdui-parser`. Putting the rule there would need a new `lint` → `metadata-core` edge (or the judge in `packages/spec`, the spec lane's). It would also fold #29051 (`os validate` / `os build`) into this PR, which the seat holds separately. Both are in the report's open questions.

## Tests

No existing assertion was edited.

New:
- `packages/metadata-core/src/flow-cycle.test.ts`: the judge on the corpus (path, closing-edge index, message), the corpus holds both verdicts, a dangling endpoint takes no part.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.flow-cycle.test.ts`: the pure gate on the corpus. Each refused case is one located `error` with the judge's message, and each accepted case has no cycle finding. Drafts are not gated (D1).
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-cycle-registration.test.ts`: `registerFlow` on the same corpus, refused exactly when the corpus names a cycle, with the judge's message. These two files are the parity pin: one corpus, both faces.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts`: the card's shape (push → check → revise → push) added as the last `CASES` row (saves, reads `valid: false`, publish refuses with the same words). New control: the same loop with its closing edge typed `back` reads `valid: true` and publishes.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/flow-undeclared-cycle-publish.dogfood.test.ts`: over the showcase composition and REST. A draft `PUT` saves, `GET ?state=draft` carries `flow-undeclared-cycle` on `edges.4` with the engine's sentence, and `publish-drafts` answers `outcome: 'refused'`. Control: the `back`-typed loop reads valid, publishes, and the by-name read shows `registration.state: registered`.

## Acceptance notes

- Sibling #29051 (`os validate` / `os build` pass a top-level cycle): `findUndeclaredFlowCycle` serves it as is. `packages/cli/src/utils/flow-region-shape.ts` already runs `validateControlFlow` per flow, and `@objectstack/cli` already depends on `@objectstack/metadata-core`. So the build face is one call in that file plus its test. That is a different file surface from this PR, so it is left to the seat's serial card.
- Same defect class, not fixed here: the gate never runs the spec's `validateControlFlow`, so a flow whose `loop` body (or `parallel` / `try_catch` region) is cyclic or malformed also passes the publish gate while `registerFlow` refuses it. Measured on the pure gate at this head: a loop body `a → b → a` gives `evaluateRuntimeAuthoringGate(...).error === null`, and `validateControlFlow` throws "loop 'lp' body: region has no entry node … region contains a cycle". This is the gate-side twin of the CLI change made for #28893.

## Verification

<details><summary>Red first on origin/main (fea2dbb7), gate fix removed, draft-verdict suite</summary>

`× flow — [flow-undeclared-cycle]: the draft saves, reads valid:false, and publish refuses with the same words`. Received `{ code: undefined, status: undefined }`: the publish was not refused.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation 1: the gate's finding removed from localIssues (src, scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, anchor 1 → 0, restored blob == HEAD)</summary>

The gate suite and the draft-verdict suite go 5 failed / 39 passed: the four refused corpus cases plus the card's draft-verdict case. The controls stay green. Restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation 2: the judge's back-edge exemption removed (metadata-core rebuilt, ablation-dist-preflight marker present in dist, then absent after restore and rebuild)</summary>

Gate + draft-verdict: 5 failed (the three back-typed controls, the two-loops case, and the draft-verdict back control). Engine registration corpus: 4 failed (the same four corpus cases). A first attempt used a block-comment marker that esbuild strips: the preflight failed, so that reading was discarded and the ablation was redone with a marker that survives the build.
</details>

<details><summary>Package suites and typecheck (before the main merge)</summary>

Under the verify lock, `typecheck` then `test` for the three packages, VERDICT command-exit 0: metadata-core 23 files / 896 tests, metadata-protocol 298 files (4 skipped) / 22074 passed (26 skipped), service-automation 258 files / 3317 tests. `eslint --no-inline-config` on every changed `.ts` file: exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates (dispatch-gates --commands, 66 families) at 8a384327</summary>

All 66 derived families exit 0; `dispatch-gates --ran` with exit codes recorded: "66 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)". Three needed a second run. `check-adr-0087-registration` was red on the first changeset text, which carried a FROM → TO label that the gate reads as a migration prescription; the changeset now states the remedy, and the gate reads it green with `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exited 3 (its fixture commit is outside the shallow clone) and is green after fetching that commit. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (seven packages outside the dogfood closure had no dist) and is green after building them (115 entries / 70 packages). The changeset-reading gates were re-run after the changeset commit, all exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Dogfood battery at the final head</summary>

Head 8a384327 (main merged at 694a118d), closure built with `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build`. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 388 passed / 3 skipped (391), Tests 3206 passed / 28 skipped (3234), no failure. The new file was also run alone with the verbose reporter: 2/2 passed (card 750 ms, control 1067 ms).
</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No `packages/spec` change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (eslint on the changed files; the repo-wide run is CI's).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
